findings.text: The finit_module system entry first checks module init permission, then rejects any flag bits outside the three documented ignore and compressed options, resolves the descriptor, and delegates loading to an inode keyed idempotent helper.

Module file loading follows a winner waiter race. The winner performs the load and completes the shared request with its status. The waiter blocks interruptibly, detaches its hash link under a spin lock when interrupted, and then reports the stored result.
File based module init requires a readable descriptor and fails otherwise, with descriptor emptiness also treated as a bad descriptor at the entry layer.

Loading from a file reads the whole content with a large upper bound, records failure statistics on read error, and on the compressed path decompresses, frees the compressed buffer, runs a post read security check, and frees the copy on security failure before handing the image to the loader.
A global lookup maps an address to an exception table entry of its owning module, returning absent when no module owns the address or when the module carries no entries.
Two global predicates report whether an address belongs to any module and whether it belongs to module text, each returning a boolean membership answer.
A global iterator walks every formed module under read side protection and stops early when the caller supplied callback reports success.
A global diagnostic prints the linked in module names with flags, then any unloaded tainted module summary, then a last unloaded trailer when present.
Address membership tests, exception table search, global iteration, and diagnostic printing all hold an RCU read side guard across module list or address structure access.

The proc modules sequence acquires the module mutex on start and releases it on stop, so the whole list walk is serialized. The stats file also holds the same mutex while emitting the duplicate failure table.
The idempotent wait path uses a dedicated spin lock only around hash unlink on interruption. A separate spin lock guards pause on oops coordination state.
Section attributes and notes attributes each consist of an attribute group header followed by a flexible trailing array of binary attributes.

Each proc modules row shows the module name and summed memory size, followed by unload information, a lifecycle word distinguishing unloading loading and live, a text base pointer hidden from unprivileged viewers, and taint flags when any are set. Unformed modules produce no row.

One unload info variant prints a reference count plus dependent module names each with a trailing separator and a permanent marker for init only modules, falling back to a dash when nothing was printed. The alternate variant always prints fixed placeholders.

Proc modules is served by start next stop show sequence operations plus open read seek and release handlers, registered as a permanent proc entry whose open records a privacy flag derived from credential visibility.

Module debug state lives under a modules directory with a read only stats file and a read only unloaded tainted file, each with open read seek and release style handlers created during initialization.

The stats file reports ever loaded and per stage failure counts, total and text sizes, per stage invalid byte totals and their wasted sum, conditional averages when denominators are present, and a bounded table of duplicate failed module names with occurrence counts and reason labels.

Stats output allocates a preamble allowance plus a capped number of fixed size rows, warns once if preamble construction exceeds its allowance, warns once on counter versus byte total mismatch, and truncates duplicate enumeration at the configured row cap.
Panic timing step equals one hundred, panic blink speed equals eighteen, and panic message buffer size equals one thousand twenty four.
Stats preamble allowance equals one thousand twenty four, duplicate failure row cap equals one hundred twelve, and per module byte allowance equals sixty four.
Module parameter prefix is the seven character string module dot. Section read bounce sizing equals three plus one hex digit per nibble of machine word width.

Section address read requires zero file position, renders the stored address for privileged viewers and null otherwise in hex form with newline, stages through a bounce buffer to account for termination, and honors the caller supplied length as an upper bound.

The unloaded tainted sequence acquires read side protection on start, advances with an RCU aware list helper, releases on stop, and renders each entry as name plus taint flags plus occurrence count on its own line.

Module memory interval nodes are ordered by base address. Comparison against a lookup key reports less when below start, greater when at or beyond start plus size, and equality on containment, giving inclusive start and exclusive end semantics.

Extended version iteration initializes only when both checksum and name section indices are nonzero, derives remaining entry count from checksum section size, and advances by one checksum slot plus one variable length name string.
The module layout helper accepts module version parameter symbol and tracepoint arguments and has no observable effect in the routed fragment.
The read only after init section set always names the ro after init data section and the jump table, and additionally names static call sites when the corresponding inline feature is enabled.
Module signature enforcement is enabled by a dedicated setter that records a persistent true value.
A global accessor returns the current taint bitmask. The mask starts cleared except for an optional build dependent randstruct bit.

The taint control handler allows reads generally but requires administrator privilege for writes, delegates numeric vector handling to a range helper, rejects writes that would set panic relevant bits from userspace when user taint isolation is enabled, and otherwise sets each requested bit individually.
Exception table search from inside the running module depends on an existing positive module reference held by the caller. Other callers must hold a read side section across the call.
Both proc modules text base display and section address reads hide the true pointer from viewers that fail a credential visibility check, substituting null.
The unloaded tainted sequence uses explicit acquire on start and release on stop annotations around its read side critical section.
Module lifecycle display maps going to unloading, coming to loading, and all other formed states to live. Global iteration, diagnostics, and proc display all skip unformed modules.
Panic timeout defaults from build configuration, panic force CPU defaults to negative one, and the all CPU backtrace control defaults to zero in both its variable and constant forms.
Interrupted idempotent waits still return the shared completion status after local unlink. Compressed load failures record stage specific counters and byte totals while releasing temporary buffers.
Panic and oops coordination state includes pause controls, crash kexec notifier selection, warn and taint panic thresholds, console replay selection, and all CPU backtrace progress flags.
A one time informational message reports that the older panic print control is deprecated in favor of separate system info and console replay controls.
Total module size is the arithmetic sum of sizes across all memory types.
Module statistics initialization publishes unsigned long and atomic debug entries for size totals, invalid byte totals, and live plus failure counts.
Duplicate failure reason labels distinguish becoming only, load only, both stages, and an unexpected fallback value.
